question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Envious."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Generous.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Envious" means feeling or showing resentment at another's advantages or possessions. (ईर्ष्यालु)

 

• "Generous" means willing to give more of something than is strictly necessary. It is therefore the correct antonym. (उदार)

◦ Example: The generous donor funded scholarships for hundreds of underprivileged students across the state.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Jealous (ईर्ष्यालु) — feeling resentment of someone's success; a synonym of envious.

• Option 2: Resentful (नाराज) — feeling bitter indignation; a synonym of envious.

• Option 3: Covetous (लालची) — having a strong desire for another's possessions; a synonym of envious.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of envious: Content, Charitable, Unselfish.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Abandon (त्यागना): Continue (जारी रखना), Retain (संभालकर रखना)

2. Abate (कम करना): Increase (बढ़ाना), Intensify (तेज करना)

3. Abjure (त्यागना): Acquire (प्राप्त करना), Accept (स्वीकार करना)

4. Abolish (समाप्त करना): Establish (स्थापित करना), Continue (जारी रखना)

5. Abominable (घृणित): Admirable (प्रशंसनीय)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Deceptive."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Honest.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Deceptive" means giving an appearance or impression different from the true one; misleading. (भ्रामक)

 

• "Honest" means free of deceit; truthful and sincere. It is therefore the correct antonym. (ईमानदार)

◦ Example: The witness gave an honest account of the accident, even though it implicated a close family friend.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

• Option 2: Misleading (भ्रामक) — giving a wrong impression; a synonym of deceptive.

• Option 3: Deceitful (छलपूर्ण) — inclined to deceive others; a synonym of deceptive.

• Option 4: Fraudulent (कपटपूर्ण) — obtained by dishonest means; a synonym of deceptive.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of deceptive: Truthful, Sincere, Candid.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Above (ऊपर): Below (नीचे), Under (नीचे)

2. Abrogate (समाप्त करना): Uphold (बनाए रखना), Maintain (कायम रखना)

3. Absolve (दोषमुक्त करना): Accuse (आरोप लगाना), Blame (दोष देना)

4. Abstract (भावात्मक): Concrete (ठोस/वास्तविक)

5. Abstruse (कठिन / गूढ़): Clear (स्पष्ट), Simple (सरल)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Servile."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Arrogant.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Servile" means excessively willing to serve or please others; submissive. (चापलूस)

 

• "Arrogant" means having an exaggerated sense of one's own importance. It is therefore the correct antonym. (घमंडी)

◦ Example: His arrogant attitude towards colleagues made it difficult for anyone to work with him.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

• Option 2: Obsequious (चापलूस) — obedient or attentive to an excessive degree; a synonym of servile.

• Option 3: Subservient (अधीनस्थ) — prepared to obey others unquestioningly; a synonym of servile.

• Option 4: Submissive (विनम्र/अधीन) — meekly obedient to others; a synonym of servile.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of servile: Independent, Assertive, Dominant.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Absurd (बेतुका): Reasonable (तार्किक), Sensible (समझदारीपूर्ण)

2. Abundant (प्रचुर): Minimal (न्यूनतम)

3. Accentuate (ज़ोर देना / उभारना): Obscure (छिपाना / अस्पष्ट करना), Downplay (महत्त्व कम करना)

4. Accept (स्वीकार करना): Deny (अस्वीकार करना), Reject (अस्वीकृत)

5. Access (पहुँच): Denial (नकार)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Devout."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Treacherous.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Devout" means deeply religious or devoted to a particular faith. (पवित्र)

 

• "Treacherous" means guilty of or involving betrayal or deceit; disloyal. It is therefore the correct antonym. (विश्वासघाती)

◦ Example: The treacherous advisor secretly leaked confidential state documents to the enemy in exchange for a large sum.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Religious (धार्मिक) — relating to belief in a faith; a synonym of devout.

• Option 2: Faithful (श्रद्धालु) — loyal and steadfast in devotion; a synonym of devout.

• Option 4: Pious (धर्मपरायण) — having deep religious devotion; a synonym of devout.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of devout: Disloyal, Traitorous, Unfaithful.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Accompany (साथ जाना): Abandon (छोड़ देना), Desert (त्याग देना)

2. Accomplish (पूरा करना): Miss (चूकना), Fail (असफल होना)

3. Accustomed (आदत वाला): Unusual (असामान्य), Unfamiliar (अपरिचित)

4. Acquisition (प्राप्ति): Loss (हानि)

5. Acquitted (दोषमुक्त): Convicted (दोषी ठहराया गया), Guilty (अपराधी)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Ideal."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Faulty.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Ideal" means most suitable; representing a standard of perfection. (आदर्श)

 

• "Faulty" means having defects or flaws; not working correctly. It is therefore the correct antonym. (दोषपूर्ण)

◦ Example: The factory recalled thousands of cars after discovering a faulty braking system in the new model.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

• Option 2: Optimal (इष्टतम) — best or most favorable under the circumstances; a synonym of ideal.

• Option 3: Perfect (परिपूर्ण) — having all the required or desirable elements; a synonym of ideal.

• Option 4: Flawless (निर्दोष) — without any imperfections or defects; a synonym of ideal.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of ideal: Imperfect, Defective, Flawed.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Active (सक्रिय): Inert (निष्क्रिय)

2. Adage (कहावत): Misconstruction (गलत अर्थ), Nonsense (बेतुकी बात)

3. Admire (प्रशंसा करना): Despise (घृणा करना), Hate (नफरत करना)

4. Advance (आगे बढ़ना): Retreat (पीछे हटना), Withdraw (वापस लेना)

5. Advanced (उन्नत): Rudimentary (प्रारंभिक)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Transient".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Permanent.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Transient" means lasting only for a short time; temporary. (क्षणिक)

◦ Example: The pain from the injury was transient, fading away completely within just a few short days.

 

• "Permanent" means lasting or intended to last indefinitely without change, and is therefore the correct antonym. (स्थायी)

◦ Example: After years of renting, the family finally found a permanent home where they planned to settle for good.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

• Option 2: Fleeting (क्षणभंगुर): passing quickly; not lasting — a synonym of transient, not an antonym.

• Option 3: Momentary (क्षणिक): lasting for a very short time — again a synonym.

• Option 4: Temporary (अस्थायी): lasting for only a limited time — close in sense to transient.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of transient: Temporary, Fleeting, Momentary, Ephemeral, Brief.

• Synonyms of permanent: Lasting, Enduring, Everlasting, Perpetual.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Adventurous (साहसी): Cautious (सावधान), Careful (सतर्क)

2. Affirm (पुष्टि करना): Refuse (इंकार करना), Deny (नकारना)

3. Affirmative (सकारात्मक): Negative (नकारात्मक), Denial (अस्वीकृति)

4. Affluent (धनी): Destitute (गरीब), Poor (निर्धन)

5. Afraid (डरना): Brave (साहसी), Courageous (वीर)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Covert".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Overt.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Covert" means not openly acknowledged or displayed; secret or hidden. (गुप्त / छिपा)

◦ Example: The intelligence agency conducted a covert operation to gather information without alerting the foreign government involved.

 

• "Overt" means done or shown openly; not secret or hidden, and is therefore the correct antonym. (खुला)

◦ Example: Their overt hostility toward the new policy was evident to everyone attending the heated public meeting.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Clandestine (गोपनीय): kept secret, often for illicit purposes — a synonym of covert, not an antonym.

• Option 2: Furtive (चोरी-छिपे का): done secretly to avoid attention — again a synonym.

• Option 4: Secret (गुप्त): kept hidden from others' knowledge — close in sense to covert.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of covert: secret, clandestine, furtive, hidden, concealed.

• Synonyms of overt: open, obvious, evident, manifest.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Allay (शांत करना): Aggravate (बढ़ाना), Worsen (खराब करना)

2. Altercation (विवाद): Compromise (समझौता), Agreement (सहमति)

3. Amateur (शौकिया): Expert (विशेषज्ञ), Professional (पेशेवर)

4. Amazed (आश्चर्यचकित): Unimpressed (प्रभावित नहीं), Indifferent (उदासीन)

5. Ambiguous (अस्पष्ट): Clear (स्पष्ट), Certain (निश्चित)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Joyous."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Melancholic.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Joyous" means full of happiness and joy. (खुशहाल)

 

• "Melancholic" means feeling or expressing pensive sadness. It is therefore the correct antonym. (उदास)

◦ Example: The poet's melancholic verses reflected the deep sorrow he felt after losing his closest friend.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Happy (खुश) — feeling or showing pleasure and contentment; a synonym of joyous.

• Option 2: Elated (उल्लासित) — filled with great happiness or pride; a synonym of joyous.

• Option 4: Delightful (आनंददायक) — causing great pleasure or delight; a synonym of joyous.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of joyous: Sad, Sorrowful, Gloomy.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Ambition (महत्वाकांक्षा): Laziness (आलस्य)

2. Ambivalent (द्वंद्वात्मक/अस्पष्ट): Clear (स्पष्ट), Unequivocal (निर्विवाद)

3. Ambrosial (सुगंधित/स्वादिष्ट): Malodorous (दुर्गंधयुक्त), Foul (बदबूदार)

4. Ameliorate (सुधारना): Worsen (बिगाड़ना), Deteriorate (खराब करना)

5. Amplify (बढ़ाना): Reduce (घटाना), Decrease (कम करना)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Secure."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Insecure.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Secure" means free from danger or risk; safe and protected. (सुरक्षित)

 

• "Insecure" means not confident or safe; uncertain and anxious. It is therefore the correct antonym. (असुरक्षित)

◦ Example: The refugees felt insecure living in a war-torn region with no stable government.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Guarded (रक्षित) — watched over and defended carefully; a synonym of secure.

• Option 3: Safe (सुरक्षित) — protected from danger or harm; a synonym of secure.

• Option 4: Protected (संरक्षित) — kept safe from harm; a synonym of secure.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of secure: Unsafe, Vulnerable, Precarious.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Amusing (मनोरंजक): Boring (उबाऊ), Dull (नीरस)

2. Angst (चिंता/गुस्सा): Calmness (शांति), Peace (सुकून)

3. Anile (बुढ़ापे जैसा): Young (युवा), Energetic (ऊर्जावान)

4. Animosity (दुश्मनी): Benevolence (भलाई), Love (प्रेम)

5. Annoyance (चिड़): Serenity (शांति), Calmness (शांत अवस्था)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Obstinate".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Docile.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Obstinate" means stubbornly refusing to change one's opinion or approach. (जिद्दी)

◦ Example: The obstinate child refused to eat vegetables no matter how his parents pleaded.

 

• "Docile" means easily managed or taught; submissive, and is therefore the correct antonym. (आज्ञाकारी)

◦ Example: The docile puppy followed every command during its very first training session.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Stubborn (हठी): unwilling to change one's mind — a synonym of obstinate, not an antonym.

• Option 3: Headstrong (जिद्दी): willful and determined to do as one wants — again a synonym.

• Option 4: Adamant (अड़ियल): refusing to be persuaded or change one's mind — close in sense to obstinate.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of obstinate: stubborn, headstrong, adamant, inflexible, unyielding.

• Synonyms of docile: obedient, compliant, submissive, tractable, meek.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Antique (प्राचीन): Modern (आधुनिक), New (नया)

2. Anxiety (चिंता): Relief (राहत)

3. Anxious (चिंतित): Calm (शांत), Relaxed (आरामदायक)

4. Apathy (उदासीनता): Enthusiasm (उत्साह), Interest (रुचि)

5. Apparition (भूत-प्रेत): Realness (वास्तविकता), Reality (हकीकत)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Incoherent."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Rational.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Incoherent" means expressed in a confused or unclear manner; lacking logical connection. (असंगत)

 

• "Rational" means based on clear reason and logic; sensible. It is therefore the correct antonym. (तर्कसंगत)

◦ Example: The committee finally reached a rational decision after carefully weighing all the available evidence.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Muddled (गड़बड़) — confused or disordered; a synonym of incoherent.

• Option 2: Disjointed (असंबद्ध) — disconnected or lacking coherence; a synonym of incoherent.

• Option 3: Confused (उलझा हुआ) — unable to think clearly; bewildered; a synonym of incoherent.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of incoherent: Logical, Coherent, Sensible.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Appreciate (सराहना करना): Depreciate (मूल्य घटाना), Criticize (आलोचना करना)

2. Approach (पास आना): Retreat (पीछे हटना), Withdraw (वापस जाना)

3. Appropriate (उचित): Improper (अनुचित)

4. Approve (स्वीकार करना): Reject (अस्वीकार करना), Disapprove (असहमति)

5. Arcane (रहस्यमय): Public (सार्वजनिक), Known (ज्ञात)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Conceal."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Reveal.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Conceal" means keep something from being known or seen. (छिपाना)

 

• "Reveal" means make previously secret or unknown information known. It is therefore the correct antonym. (प्रकट करना)

◦ Example: The scientist decided to reveal her groundbreaking findings at the international conference.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Mask (छिपाना) — cover or disguise something; a synonym of conceal.

• Option 2: Disguise (भेस बदलना) — change appearance to prevent recognition; a synonym of conceal.

• Option 3: Hide (छिपाना) — put or keep out of sight; a synonym of conceal.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of conceal: Expose, Disclose, Divulge.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Arraign (आरोप लगाना): Justify (सही ठहराना), Defend (बचाव करना)

2. Arrival (आगमन): Departure (प्रस्थान), Exit (निकास)

3. Ascend (ऊपर जाना): Descend (नीचे उतरना), Fall (गिरना)

4. Assert (दावा करना): Deny (इंकार करना), Reject (अस्वीकार करना)

5. Astute (तीक्ष्ण): Stupid (मूर्ख)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Abundant".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Minimal.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Abundant" means existing or available in very large quantities; plentiful. (प्रचुर)

◦ Example: The region enjoys abundant rainfall each monsoon, making it ideal for growing rice.

 

• "Minimal" means of the smallest possible amount, quantity, or degree, and is therefore the correct antonym. (न्यूनतम)

◦ Example: The company operated with minimal staff during the holiday season in order to cut costs.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Ample (पर्याप्त): enough or more than enough — a synonym of abundant, not an antonym.

• Option 2: Plentiful (प्रचुर): existing in great quantity — again a synonym.

• Option 3: Copious (विपुल): abundant in supply or quantity — close in sense to abundant.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of abundant: Plentiful, Ample, Copious, Bountiful, Profuse.

• Synonyms of minimal: Scant, Meager, Negligible, Slight, Sparse.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Attack (हमला): Defend (रक्षा करना), Protect (सुरक्षा करना)

2. Attention (ध्यान): Disregard (अनदेखी), Ignore (नज़रअंदाज़)

3. Attenuate (कमजोर करना): Strong (मजबूत), Strengthen (मजबूत करना)

4. Attracts (आकर्षित करता है): Deters (रोकता है)

5. Audacity (दुस्साहस): Cowardice (कायरता), Fear (भय)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Fetid."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Fragrant.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Fetid" means having an extremely unpleasant smell; stinking. (बदबूदार)

 

• "Fragrant" means having a pleasant or sweet smell. It is therefore the correct antonym. (सुगंधित)

◦ Example: The garden was filled with fragrant roses that perfumed the air throughout the summer evening.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Rank (तीखी बदबू वाला) — having a strong, unpleasant smell; a synonym of fetid.

• Option 3: Foul (गंदा) — offensive to the senses; disgusting; a synonym of fetid.

• Option 4: Putrid (सड़ा हुआ) — decaying and foul-smelling; a synonym of fetid.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of fetid: Pleasant, Aromatic, Sweet-smelling.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Authorize (अनुमति देना): Forbid (मनाही करना), Prohibit (प्रतिबंध लगाना)

2. Autonomy (स्वायत्तता): Dependence (निर्भरता), Subordination (अधीनता)

3. Avariciousness (लालच): Generosity (उदारता)

4. Average (सामान्य): Exceptional (असाधारण), Outstanding (उत्कृष्ट)

5. Axiom (स्पष्ट सत्य): Absurdity (बेतुकी बात), Falsehood (असत्य)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Pernicious."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Innocuous.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Pernicious" means having a harmful effect, especially in a gradual or subtle way. (हानिकारक)

 

• "Innocuous" means not harmful or offensive; harmless. It is therefore the correct antonym. (हानिरहित)

◦ Example: The doctor assured her that the small skin rash was completely innocuous and would fade soon.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Destructive (विनाशकारी) — causing great and irreparable damage; a synonym of pernicious.

• Option 2: Harmful (नुकसानदेह) — causing or capable of causing harm; a synonym of pernicious.

• Option 3: Damaging (क्षतिकारक) — causing harm or injury; a synonym of pernicious.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of pernicious: Harmless, Benign, Safe.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Babble (बकबक करना): Quiet (शांत), Silence (चुप्पी)

2. Barbarity (क्रूरता): Compassion (दयालुता), Humanity (मानवता)

3. Barbarous (असभ्य): Civilized (सभ्य), Cultured (संस्कृत)

4. Barren (बंजर): Fertile (उपजाऊ), Productive (उत्पादक)

5. Bashful (संकोची / शर्मीला): Loquacious (बातूनी), Confident (आत्मविश्वासी)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Languid".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Vigorous.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Languid" means lacking energy or vitality; slow and relaxed. (सुस्त)

◦ Example: The afternoon heat left the travellers languid, and they rested for hours beneath the shade of a large tree.

 

• "Vigorous" means strong, healthy, and full of energy, and is therefore the correct antonym. (ऊर्जावान)

◦ Example: The vigorous young athlete trained for hours each day, determined to qualify for the national championships.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

• Option 2: Sluggish (मंदगति): slow-moving or lacking energy — a synonym of languid, not an antonym.

• Option 3: Lethargic (सुस्त): lacking energy; sluggish — again a synonym.

• Option 4: Listless (उदासीन): lacking energy or enthusiasm — close in sense to languid.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of languid: Lethargic, Sluggish, Listless, Lazy, Weary.

• Synonyms of vigorous: Energetic, Robust, Dynamic, Lively.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Benevolent (दयालु): Malevolent (दुष्ट), Cruel (क्रूर)

2. Blistering (बहुत गर्म): Chilly (ठंडा), Cool (शीतल)

3. Bloom (खिलना): Wither (मुरझाना), Fade (मंद पड़ना)

4. Boastful (घमंडी): Modest (नम्र), Humble (विनम्र)

5. Bold (साहसी): Timid (डरपोक), Cowardly (कायर)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Late".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Early.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Late" means occurring or arriving after the expected or usual time. (देरी से)

◦ Example: The train was late by nearly an hour, causing many commuters to miss their connecting flights.

 

• "Early" means happening or arriving before the usual or expected time, and is therefore the correct antonym. (जल्दी)

◦ Example: She always arrives early for meetings, giving herself time to prepare before everyone else appears.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Delayed (विलंबित): made to happen later than planned — a synonym of late, not an antonym.

• Option 2: Overdue (समय-सीमा से अधिक): not having happened by the expected time — again a synonym.

• Option 4: Tardy (देरी करने वाला): slow to act or arrive — close in sense to late.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of late: Delayed, Overdue, Tardy, Belated, Behind.

• Synonyms of early: Prompt, Timely, Punctual, Advance.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Bombastic (आडंबरपूर्ण): Simple (सरल)

2. Brittle (भंगुर): Resilient (लचीला), Strong (मजबूत)

3. Bulging (फूला हुआ): Contracting (सिकुड़ता हुआ), Shrinking (सिकुड़ता हुआ)

4. Bulk (बड़ा भाग): Handful (थोड़ा)

5. Bumpy (ऊबड़-खाबड़): Steady (स्थिर), Smooth (चिकना)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Authorize."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Forbid.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Authorize" means give official permission for or approval to something. (अनुमति देना)

 

• "Forbid" means refuse to allow something; prohibit it. It is therefore the correct antonym. (मनाही करना)

◦ Example: The school rules strictly forbid the use of mobile phones during examinations and formal classroom sessions.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Sanction (मंज़ूरी देना) — give official permission or approval for an action; a synonym of authorize.

• Option 2: Permit (अनुमति देना) — give official permission for something; a synonym of authorize.

• Option 4: Approve (स्वीकार करना) — confirm or accept something as satisfactory; a synonym of authorize.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of authorize: Prohibit, Ban, Disallow.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Cacophony (कर्कश ध्वनि): Symphony (मधुर संगीत), Euphony (मधुर ध्वनि)

2. Cacophony (शोर): Harmony (सामंजस्य), Melody (मधुरता)

3. Cajole (फुसलाना / चापलूसी करना): Bully (धमकाना), Coerce (बलपूर्वक बाध्य करना)

4. Callous (निर्दयी): Sympathetic (सहानुभूतिपूर्ण), Kind (दयालु)

5. Calm (शांत): Agitate (उत्तेजित), Disturb (परेशान करना)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Triumphant."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Defeated.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Triumphant" means having won a victory or achieved success; celebrating a win. (विजयी)

 

• "Defeated" means having lost a battle, game, or contest. It is therefore the correct antonym. (पराजित)

◦ Example: The defeated team walked silently off the field, heads down after their unexpected loss in the finals.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Winning (जीतने वाला) — gaining or resulting in victory; a synonym of triumphant.

• Option 3: Victorious (विजयी) — having won a victory; successful; a synonym of triumphant.

• Option 4: Successful (सफल) — achieving the desired aim or result; a synonym of triumphant.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of triumphant: Unsuccessful, Beaten, Vanquished.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Camouflage (छिपाना): Reveal (प्रकट करना), Expose (उजागर करना)

2. Candid (स्पष्टवादी / निष्कपट): Guarded (संकोची / सतर्क), Deceitful (कपटपूर्ण)

3. Capricious (चंचल): Stable (स्थिर), Consistent (नियमित)

4. Captivity (कैद): Liberty (स्वतंत्रता), Freedom (आजादी)

5. Care (परवाह): Disregard (उपेक्षा)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Trivial."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Important.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Trivial" means of little value or importance; not worth serious attention. (तुच्छ)

 

• "Important" means of great significance or value; deserving serious attention. It is therefore the correct antonym. (महत्वपूर्ण)

◦ Example: It is important for every citizen to vote in national elections to help protect democracy.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

• Option 2: Insignificant (नगण्य) — too small or unimportant to be worth consideration; a synonym of trivial.

• Option 3: Minor (मामूली) — lesser in importance, seriousness, or significance; a synonym of trivial.

• Option 4: Petty (तुच्छ) — of little importance; trivial; a synonym of trivial.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of trivial: Significant, Crucial, Essential.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Casual (अनौपचारिक): Formal (औपचारिक)

2. Catastrophe (तबाही): Success (सफलता), Blessing (आशीर्वाद)

3. Celebrated (प्रसिद्ध): Inglorious (अप्रसिद्ध), Unknown (अज्ञात)

4. Celerity (तेजी): Slowness (धीमापन), Delay (देरी)

5. Chagrin (खीज/परेशानी): Pleasure (आनंद), Amusement (मनोरंजन)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Delay."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Hasten.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Delay" means to make something happen later than planned; to postpone. (देरी करना)

 

• "Hasten" means to hurry or cause something to happen sooner. It is therefore the correct antonym. (जल्दी करना)

◦ Example: The doctor advised the family to hasten the patient's transfer to a better-equipped hospital immediately.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Stall (विलंब करना) — to delay in order to gain time; a synonym of delay.

• Option 3: Defer (टालना) — to put off to a later time; a synonym of delay.

• Option 4: Postpone (स्थगित करना) — to arrange for a later time; a synonym of delay.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of delay: Accelerate, Expedite, Rush.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Charming (आकर्षक): Repulsive (घिनौना), Unattractive (अनाकर्षक)

2. Chastise (सजा देना): Praise (प्रशंसा करना), Reward (पुरस्कृत करना)

3. Chicanery (छल): Honesty (ईमानदारी), Integrity (सत्यनिष्ठा)

4. Chided (डांटा): Applauded (सराहा), Praised (प्रशंसा की)

5. Chivalrous (उदार): Cowardly (कायर), Defiant (अवज्ञाकारी)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Commendable".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Blameworthy.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Commendable" means deserving praise or approval; admirable in conduct. (प्रशंसनीय)

◦ Example: Her commendable efforts to help flood victims earned her recognition from the state government.

 

• "Blameworthy" means deserving blame; responsible for wrongdoing, and is therefore the correct antonym. (निंदनीय)

◦ Example: The auditor found the company's blameworthy negligence responsible for the massive financial losses.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Laudable (सराहनीय): deserving praise and commendation — a synonym of commendable, not an antonym.

• Option 2: Admirable (प्रशंसनीय): arousing admiration — again a synonym.

• Option 3: Praiseworthy (प्रशंसनीय): deserving praise — close in sense to commendable.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of commendable: praiseworthy, admirable, laudable, meritorious, creditable.

• Synonyms of blameworthy: culpable, reprehensible, guilty, censurable, faulty.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Chronic (पुराना): Temporary (अस्थायी), Acute (अल्पकालिक)

2. Clandestine (गुप्त): Open (खुला), Public (सार्वजनिक)

3. Clear (साफ/स्पष्ट): Nebulous (अस्पष्ट), Opaque (अपारदर्शी)

4. Cogent (तार्किक): Unconvincing (अविश्वसनीय), Weak (कमज़ोर तर्क)

5. Coherent (व्यवस्थित): Disorganized (अव्यवस्थित)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Apathy".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Enthusiasm.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Apathy" means lack of interest, enthusiasm, or concern. (उदासीनता)

◦ Example: Voter apathy has become a growing concern for political parties trying to increase turnout in elections.

 

• "Enthusiasm" means intense and eager enjoyment, interest, or approval, and is therefore the correct antonym. (उत्साह)

◦ Example: The new coach brought tremendous enthusiasm to the team, inspiring players to train harder every day.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

• Option 2: Listlessness (सुस्ती): lack of energy or enthusiasm — a synonym of apathy, not an antonym.

• Option 3: Unconcern (बेपरवाही): a lack of anxiety or interest — again a synonym.

• Option 4: Indifference (उदासीनता): lack of interest, concern, or sympathy — close in sense to apathy.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of apathy: indifference, unconcern, listlessness, detachment, lethargy.

• Synonyms of enthusiasm: eagerness, zeal, passion, excitement, fervor.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Colorful (रंगीन): Monochrome (एकरंगी), Dull (फीका)

2. Commend (प्रशंसा करना): Criticize (आलोचना करना), Condemn (निंदा करना)

3. Commendable (प्रशंसनीय): Blameworthy (निंदनीय), Bad (बुरा)

4. Compassion (सहानुभूति): Meanness (कठोरता), Cruelty (क्रूरता)

5. Compelled (मजबूर): Demur (आपत्ति करना), Free (स्वतंत्र)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Captivity".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Liberty.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Captivity" means the state of being imprisoned or confined. (कैद)

◦ Example: After years of captivity, the endangered tigers were finally released into a protected wildlife reserve.

 

• "Liberty" means the state of being free from confinement or restriction, and is therefore the correct antonym. (स्वतंत्रता)

◦ Example: The prisoners celebrated their newfound liberty after the court overturned their wrongful conviction.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Imprisonment (कारावास): the act of putting in prison — a synonym of captivity, not an antonym.

• Option 3: Confinement (कैद): state of being enclosed or restricted — again a synonym.

• Option 4: Bondage (बंधन): state of being enslaved or bound — close in sense to captivity.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of captivity: confinement, imprisonment, bondage, custody, detention.

• Synonyms of liberty: freedom, independence, autonomy, emancipation, release.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Complaint (शिकायत): Praise (प्रशंसा), Appreciation (सराहना)

2. Compulsory (अनिवार्य): Voluntary (स्वैच्छिक), Optional (वैकल्पिक)

3. Conceal (छिपाना): Reveal (प्रकट करना), Expose (उजागर करना)

4. Concede (स्वीकार करना): Deny (नकारना)

5. Conceit (अहंकार): Modesty (विनम्रता)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Purify".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Pollute.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Purify" means to remove contaminants or impurities from something. (शुद्ध करना)

◦ Example: The new filtration system can purify thousands of liters of drinking water every single day.

 

• "Pollute" means to contaminate something, especially with harmful substances, and is therefore the correct antonym. (प्रदूषित करना)

◦ Example: Factories that pollute nearby rivers face heavy fines under the new environmental protection law.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Filter (छानना): to pass through a device to remove impurities — a synonym of purify, not an antonym.

• Option 2: Cleanse (साफ करना): to make thoroughly clean — again a synonym.

• Option 4: Refine (परिष्कृत करना): to remove impurities to improve quality — close in sense to purify.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of purify: cleanse, refine, filter, clarify, decontaminate.

• Synonyms of pollute: contaminate, taint, defile, foul, dirty.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Concentrate (एकत्र करना): Disperse (बिखेरना), Scatter (छितराना)

2. Concomitant (सहगामी): Independent (स्वतंत्र), Separate (अलग)

3. Condemned (निंदा करना / दोषी ठहराना): Praised (प्रशंसा करना), Approved (स्वीकृत करना)

4. Confronted (सामना किया): Avoided (टाला), Evaded (बच निकला)

5. Conjecture (अनुमान लगाना): Certainty (निश्चितता), Definitely (निश्चित रूप से)
